claim: Try it with sample data opens a separate 24-hour workspace without changing real browser or lesson data.
where: landing primary action, demo banner, README
sandbox: fresh 390px browser context; seed sentinel real keys; open /demo; assert only demo:clc:workspace changes; reset and assert a new workspace id

claim: Learners share only consented status, selected output, and an optional note; common secrets are redacted and output is capped at 8,000 characters.
where: landing, lesson form, evidence dialog, privacy page, README
sandbox: fresh synthetic lesson; reject unconsented evidence; submit a credential plus 8,100 characters; assert stored redaction, cap, note, tutor reply, and cleanup

claim: The sample lesson reloads offline after its first visit.
sandbox: fresh browser context; register service worker; load /demo; set that context offline; reload and assert the sample plus visible offline state

claim: Tutors can export a lesson record as JSON.
where: tutor and demo toolbars, pricing, README
sandbox: fresh /demo workspace; download JSON; parse it and assert the sample title, three checkpoints, and blocked evidence

claim: Pair is free and Team archive is a $39 one-time purchase through the Sociobot hosted checkout.
sandbox: fresh pricing page; assert price and one-time copy; request the advertised checkout without following it; assert 303 to checkout.dodopayments.com

claim: No advertising trackers or third-party analytics run in the public or demo flow, and no source-file upload is offered.
sandbox: fresh browser context; record every request across / and /demo; assert same-origin only and no file input
